title: Both in the Carrier
hook: Both cats are boxed. A person is in the crosswalk.
scene: Overcast midday on a two-lane downtown street. The Menace is in the right travel lane, moving. The carrier sits on the true floor to the right of the tunnel — not on the seat base — door latched, a strap around the box and the seat post. Gracie and Mya are both inside — orange with a cream chest, brown with a dark stripe — visible through the grate. Ahead through the mesh, a person in a dark coat is already in the marked crosswalk in this same lane, one shoe on the white paint. The full-width nose plow points at that person. The right foot covers the brake — heel planted, ball hovering over the pad. The cats are cargo in a closed box. The person in the paint is the decision.
debrief: Animals ride in a closed, strapped carrier on the floor. The person in the crosswalk is the decision you can see because the load stayed down.

source.teaching_target: Pets ride in a closed strapped carrier on the floor; a person already in the marked crosswalk stays visible ahead.
